name: play stats with yards_gained filter on one column only does not leak to siblings
description: Regression for measure-batch group_key bug: when one play-stat column carries a per-column filter (yards_gained) and sibling play-stat columns sharing the same apply_filters source do not, the sibling columns must NOT inherit the filter. Previously they all batched into one CTE keyed by apply_filters.toString().

player_gamelogs_year_2024.nfl_team) as teams from "player_gamelogs_year_2024" left join "nfl_games" on "nfl_games"."esbid" = "player_gamelogs_year_2024"."esbid" where
